title: Qwen releases open AI model Qwen-Drive-1.0 for autonomous vehicles
summary: Qwen-Drive-1.0 is a multimodal Qwen3.5-4B model that understands road conditions, answers questions about the surroundings, and plans vehicle movement. It processes multi-camera images, builds 3D environment models, detects objects, and generates trajectories for 5 seconds. Weights and code released under Apache 2.0.
